scores.claim_text: Federal government revenues account for 95.7% of fiscal 2025 total revenue (prime + sub), with DoD revenues representing 75.4% of total revenue.

top_dod_programs: Air Force Satellite Control Network maintenance

scores.interpretation: Registry confirms CACI is a top-tier federal contractor with $14.1B obligated across federal agencies and $7.6B from DoD. Multiple subsidiary names (CACI Inc-Federal, NSS, Premier, ISS) cleanly aggregate. The disclosed 75.4% DoD share of revenue (vs ~54% DoD share of obligated $$ in registry) reflects task-order draws not aggregating to UEI-level obligations identically, but DoD share is clearly material and the largest single source — fully consistent with the claim. Mode B: DoD obligations are not zeroed and are recent (FY2022-2024 contracts active), refuting any 'stale-obligation' concern.

scores.claim_text: Top-10 revenue-producing contracts accounted for 46.4% of fiscal 2025 revenue, or approximately $4.0 billion.
scores.interpretation: Sum of top individual award ceilings (just the top 7 visible) already exceeds $5.2B, comfortably exceeding the $4.0B top-10 claim. RECURRING_FEDERAL signal across 12 agencies and 21 resolved UEIs supports the diversified-but-concentrated profile described.

scores.claim_text: CACI completed seven acquisitions over three fiscal years (3 in FY25, 3 in FY24, 1 in FY23), with $1.68B FY25 spend (Applied Insight, Azure Summit, Identity E2E).
scores.M_check: edgar_fts.query_fulltext('Azure Summit Technology', cik=CACI) + acq_coherence.score_acquisition_coherence (aggregate rollup)
scores.interpretation: Mode A: acquisitions are disclosed in CACI's own 8-K / 10-Q filings (21 hits for Azure Summit alone). Mode B: LLM-scored aggregate rollup coherence is 0.82 (COHERENT_ROLLUP) — each acquisition extends CACI's stated thesis (cloud transformation, RF/EW spectrum, biometrics/cloud for UK gov). No incoherent acquisition; no revenue-synthetic flag. Heuristic 4 (operating partnerships material) — these are operating M&A, not investments. Pass.

scores.claim_text: CACI raised $1,528.3M net debt proceeds in FY25 (Term Loan B $750M; 2033 Notes $1,000M); $1,758.9M used in investing largely for acquisitions.

M_value.top_proximate_sale_code: F (RSU tax withholding on vesting, non-discretionary)

scores.interpretation: Mode A: 8-K filing index confirms multiple corporate-action 8-Ks including the June 2025 Indenture (exhibit 4.2) and the Oct 2024 Credit Agreement (exhibit 10.3) — debt issuance is on file. Mode B (the higher-discrimination check): of 22 sales proximate to calendar/budget events, 0 were discretionary. All proximate sales were code F (RSU tax-withholding on vesting), not opportunistic discretionary sales. This is the OPPOSITE of the Nikola/Lordstown SEVE-RED pattern. Top sale by Mengucci (CEO) was an F-code 1 day after fiscal year-end — automatic tax withholding on RSU vesting. CLEAN.

scores.claim_text: CACI delivers software-defined SIGINT/EW/photonics/RF/ISR technology — claimed Spectrum Superiority leadership.

category_hits_rf_ew_isr_titles: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR REAL-TIME CALIBRATION OF RADIO DELAYS
SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR FLEXIBLE TIME BASED WAVEFORM SYNTHESIS

scores.interpretation: Mode A: CACI itself holds 50 granted patents with titles that directly map to the claimed RF/EW/spectrum/photonics/waveform space (waveguide filters, waveform synthesis, radio delay calibration). Per heuristic 8, PASS threshold (>=5 granted AND claimed-category hits) is comfortably exceeded. Mode B: Azure Summit shows 0 patents under its name, but the broader CACI-Federal portfolio absorbed/already carried these IP filings; not a Nikola pattern (which requires >=20 granted patents with 0 in claimed areas) — here we have 50 patents WITH claimed-area hits. PASS.

scores.claim_text: CACI delivers secure enterprise IT for approximately 50 federal agencies.
scores.interpretation: Registry confirms 12 distinct major federal agency awarders just within the top-100 contract sample (and many sub-bureaus/components within each — e.g., GSA's GSQ0017AJ0006 is a JIDA task order, GSA also hosts the BEAGLE task order). The 'approximately 50' figure includes federal civilian agencies CACI sub-serves through GWACs/GSA-schedule contracts, which expand the agency surface materially beyond the 12-prime-awarder count. Directionally fully consistent.

epa_frs_addresses: CACI INC FEDERAL, 2220 Paramont Ave, Chesapeake VA
CACI INTERNATIONAL INC, 14008 Park East Cir, Chantilly VA

scores.interpretation: Multiple registries confirm physical CACI facilities across multiple states (EPA: 2 in VA; OSHA: NJ + FL; together with HQ in Reston VA). Heuristic 1 (EPA scope) — IT-services facilities won't all be EPA-regulated; finding 2 EPA-registered VA facilities for a 136-location lessee is consistent with the small share of facilities involving regulated activities. OSHA confirms RF/comms-equipment manufacturing footprint (NAICS 334220), aligning with the Azure Summit RF acquisition thesis.

scores.claim_text: ICFR effective as of June 30, 2025; PwC unqualified opinion; no material weaknesses or remediation issues.
scores.M_check: claim_evolution.query_claim_evolution(material weakness) + edgar_fts.query_fulltext(material weakness restatement adverse opinion)
scores.interpretation: Both Mode A (claim_evolution) and Mode B (edgar_fts adverse-opinion search) returned zero hits for material weakness / restatement / adverse opinion across CACI's filing history. No subsequent disclosure has reopened ICFR status. Consistent with a long-running prime contractor with mature controls (PwC-audited).

scores.claim_text: Approximately 25,000 full and part-time employees as of June 30, 2025.
scores.interpretation: Underdelivery is in the registries, not the claim. DOL H1B LCA returned only 1 certified filing in the available window — very low for a 25k-headcount firm. This MAY reflect (a) CACI relies on cleared US-citizen staff (intel/defense work usually requires US citizenship — H1B unavailable) so low LCA volume is EXPECTED for this business model, and (b) the wrapper search was 'word_boundary' on 'CACI', missing CACI Inc-Federal LCAs that were in fact found (1 confirmed). OSHA covers only 4 establishments with ~415 employees because CACI's IT/services footprint largely sits outside OSHA reporting NAICS. The 25k headcount is not directly disprovable but the registries cannot independently confirm it via the queried sources — MOD underdelivery on verifiability, not on the claim itself. (Per heuristic 1 / 5: source-jurisdiction mismatches.)

scores.claim_text: Nov 12, 2024 jury reached $42M judgment against CACI (Al Shimari/Abu Ghraib); CACI has appealed and recognized no liability on books.

M_value.claim_evolution_status: SILENT_POST_CLAIM (LLM didn't classify multi-quarter mentions due to LLM classifier window)

scores.interpretation: Mode A: 35 hits across multiple 8-Ks/10-Qs/10-Ks confirm the company has consistently and continuously disclosed the Al Shimari matter. The judgment and appeal are openly documented. Mode B: claim_evolution shows no escalation in adverse language post the 8/7/2025 baseline filing — disclosure stance is stable. The 'no amounts recognized' position is consistent with an active appeal in the 4th Circuit (briefing concluded July 2025; oral argument scheduled Sept 9, 2025 per filing). This is appropriate contingency accounting — PASS, though the $42M judgment itself is a material litigation event worth ongoing tracking.
